Brian Tse is the founder and chief executive of Concordia AI, an AI safety and governance organisation with offices in Beijing and Singapore. He is an AI Governance Advisor to the World AI Conference and an expert member of China’s AI Industry Alliance safety committee. Prior to founding Concordia AI in 2020, he was a senior advisor to the Partnership on AI and consulted with Open AI.
